spots.line: The bailey grass is knee high. Nobody has drilled in it for a year.
The ramp up is cut for horses that this keep no longer has.
The rampart walk. From up here the thorn scrub runs to the horizon.

chests.line: A quartermaster's chest, inventoried in a hand that stops mid-line.
A strongbox let into the rampart, and the key long since thrown into the scrub.

people.name: a knight of the muster
chatter: Knee high. It was ankle high when I swore in.
We drill in the scrub now. It is honest ground, at least.

people.name: Ilm the Butler
chatter: Ser Valis takes his supper in the hall. Alone. Every night.
The thorn comes in under the door. I sweep it back out.

people.name: a caterpillar on the rampart
chatter: It walks the wall all day. Eight feet make short work of a rampart.
